title: Great for keeping in the car!
review_text:
This is a great balance of portability and function! We have a larger jogging stroller already that is awesome to walk with but very difficult to fold and keep in the car, so we have been using a cheap umbrella stroller in the car when we go out. Umbrella strollers fold well and small, but that's about all the positive things I can say about them! They are uncomfortable to push, the wheels never cooperate, it is a little too short for either of us, no storage, etc. This, however, is an incredible combination of what we love about the jogging stroller while also being very easy to fold and bring with us in the car! It does not take up a lot of space, and really is surprisingly light.
I like the removable cup holder (folds flatter without it, but I'd keep it in the trunk just in case we ever want to snap it on!), and wheels are generous enough to make it easy to push. The folding is incredible- there's a strap in the middle of the seat that you pull up on and it collapses almost effortlessly.
Only issue is opening it up seems a little more complicated. You have to move the plastic lock out of the way, then pull to open it up, but then it seems to not really want to lock into place without using two hands to push back on the hinge until it clicks. I kept looking at the instructions to see if I was missing something obvious, but it seems that's just how it works. A minor compromise, I still like it.
sentence: This is a great balance of portability and function!
